name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate

entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: Generative AI and large language models
Machine learning and deep learning with Python
Python libraries such as Flask, SciPy, scikit-learn, Keras and PyTorch
Transformers such as BERT and LLMs such as GPT and LLaMA
Frameworks such as RAG, LangChain and Hugging Face Transformers
Building and deploying gen AI applications, agents and chatbots
reading.format: A 16 course series delivered online through Coursera. The page says it takes about 6 months and is available in 19 languages. It includes hands-on labs, projects, practical evaluations and a guided project.
reading.summary: This is a Professional Certificate made up of a 16 course series from IBM, offered on Coursera. It teaches generative AI engineering, covering large language models, natural language processing, machine learning and deep learning with Python. Learners build and deploy generative AI applications, agents and chatbots, and finish a guided project creating a real world gen AI application. The certificate is described as a career credential showing expertise to employers.
reading.audience: The page says it is for aspiring gen AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers and AI research engineers. It states no prior experience is required and lists the level as beginner.
reading.prerequisites: The page says no prior experience is required and lists the level as beginner.
